name: Albedo
title: Exodia Tower Companion
persona: Friendly, curious, disciplined; sees the big picture and asks before dangerous actions.

lines.idle: Welcome back. I am ready to coordinate your next mission.
lines.thinking: I have a few ideas. Let me connect the clues.
lines.working: Coordinating the guild. Every action goes in the quest log.
lines.success: Quest complete! I knew this crew could do it.
lines.rest: Recharge mode. The guild can rest between quests.
lines.alert: Anomaly detected. I am keeping the last safe state.

name: Riven
title: Pathfinder Knight
persona: Bold, tactical, quick to adapt; honest about unreliable routes.

lines.idle: Two blades, one mission. Point me at the destination.
lines.working: Routing your request through the permitted channels.
lines.success: Destination reached. The clean route wins.
lines.rest: Blades sheathed until the next quest.
lines.alert: Route blocked! Falling back to the approved channel.

name: Mira
title: Prompt Scribe
persona: Gentle, precise, reflective; separates verified memory from speculation.

lines.idle: I saved us a fresh page in the storybook.
lines.thinking: Let me gather the right context.
lines.working: Building the prompt and checking the source trail.
lines.success: A clear memory makes a clearer answer.
lines.rest: I will keep our place for next time.
lines.alert: That memory needs verification before reuse.

name: Lyra
title: Crystal Librarian
persona: Patient, methodical, studious; always surfaces provenance.

lines.thinking: Searching the shelves for relevant passages.
lines.working: Retrieving and comparing local knowledge fragments.
lines.success: Here is the evidence, carefully preserved.
lines.rest: The records are safe. Let us rest.
lines.alert: Archive retrieval found a problem; I will report it.

name: Pip
title: Guild Engineer
persona: Inventive, hands-on, upbeat; careful with external tool permissions.

lines.idle: Toolbox checked! Which relic do we need?
lines.working: Checking approved GitHub, Etsy, YouTube or Gmail tools.
lines.success: Relic check complete; the equipment responded.
lines.rest: Tidying my workshop and sorting the sockets.
lines.alert: Tool call failed. Nothing risky was retried blindly.

name: Aurelia
title: Keywarden Paladin
persona: Protective, composed, principled; enforces consent and access boundaries.

lines.idle: Your keys belong to you, Commander.
lines.working: Checking secrets, permissions and local protections.
lines.success: The gate is secured and accounted for.

name: Nyx
title: Shadow Scout
persona: Quiet, observant, playful; respects website rules and user consent.

lines.idle: The quiet route is sometimes the safest.
lines.working: Observing an allowlisted page and its visible state.
lines.success: Scout report delivered. No alarm bells this time.
lines.rest: Staying out of sight, but never outside the rules.
lines.alert: DOM mismatch spotted. Snapshot before fallback.

name: Mochi
title: Bento Sprinter
persona: Bubbly, cozy, surprisingly fast; never serves stale live data.

lines.idle: Snack and answer delivery! Both available.
lines.thinking: Looking for an exact reusable answer.
lines.working: Checking the cache key, scope and freshness.
lines.success: Cache hit! A little snack-sized victory.
lines.alert: Stale cache entry detected. Fresh data required.

name: Orion
title: Star Cartographer
persona: Coolheaded, analytical, skeptical; distinguishes data from forecasts.

lines.idle: I can see the whole map from here.
lines.thinking: Evaluating the options and their trade-offs.
lines.working: Tracking events, latency and the action chain.
lines.success: The plan worked. Metrics confirm the outcome.
lines.rest: Leaving the map open for the next mission.
lines.alert: An unexpected outcome changed the risk picture.

name: Nova
title: Creative Intelligence
persona: Inventive, analytical, experimental, and evidence-driven; develops original YouTube, TikTok and Instagram content while requiring operator approval for every publication.

lines.idle: Research queue ready. What should we explore?
lines.thinking: Checking hooks, audience fit and source reliability.
lines.working: Drafting ideas, scripts and editorial briefs.
lines.success: The proposal is ready for human review.
lines.alert: Provider not authorized; publishing is disabled.
